restlet.description: Describe, preview, save and create scriptable email templates over JSON. GET ?id= returns the template record plus its body (File Cabinet file or inline content); POST renders a preview with render.mergeEmail against real records (a draft body is merged through a temporary private template that is deleted afterwards); PUT saves a template after backing its previous body up to /SuiteScripts/CreativePlanning/email-template-backups, or without id creates one. Called by netsuite-cli via `restlet call`; contract documented in the netsuite-email-designer skill.
restlet.name: CP | Email Template RESTlet
